children: NC Corp.'s revenue should get a lift next year from new game launches, Citi analyst Alicia Yap says in a note. With management expecting to launch about 10 new games, starting with "Astrae Oratio" in 1Q, Citi expects 2027 revenue to rise 18% to 3.3 trillion won. Mobile casual games are expected to contribute about 22% of the revenue. However, Citi cuts NC's target price to 338,000 won from 350,000 won to factor in a sector derating, valuing the stock at 18 times 2027 earnings instead of 20 times. Citi maintains a buy rating, saying NC remains its preferred Korean gaming stock. Shares are up 1.7% at 189,200 won.(venkat.pr@wsj.com)
